# LabelledInput

The reference's filled field: a mono micro-label over a borderless input on the sunken surface.

## Anatomy

A bordered block on the sunken surface, holding the label and the input, with an error beneath when invalid.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` *(required)* | `string` | — | — |
| `value` | `string` | `$bindable('')` | — |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `''` | — |
| `type` | `'text' \| 'email' \| 'url' \| 'tel' \| 'search' \| 'number'` | `'text'` | — |
| `error` | `string` | `''` | — |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | — |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` | — |
| `id` | `string` | ``sanctum-labelled-input-${crypto.randomUUID()}`` | — |

## Variants

None. A field on the base surface is a `Field`.

## States

Default, focus-within, disabled, invalid.

## Keyboard

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| `Tab` | Moves to and from the input. |

## ARIA

A native `<input>` associated by `for`/`id`. The error is joined by `aria-describedby` and sets `aria-invalid`.

## Accessibility acceptance criteria

- Reachable, operable and leavable by keyboard alone, with a focus indicator meeting 3:1 in both schemes.
- An accessible name for every control, and current state exposed programmatically.
- No meaning carried by colour alone.
- Legible and operable at a 360px viewport and at desktop width, and at 200% zoom.
- Interactive targets at least 44 × 44px on touch-capable viewports.

## Recorded deviations

| What | Why |
| --- | --- |
| `--ui-border-hairline` | The reference leaves the resting border transparent, so the field has no visible boundary until it is focused. |
| The resting border is visible. | The reference makes it transparent until focus, so the field has no boundary at rest and cannot be identified as a control. |
| A focus indicator was added. | The reference's only focus signal is that transparent border turning to ink, which does not meet the 3:1 an indicator needs. |
